text:
But at night

you have your rice

and your fried beans,

with fresh

curds,

and a hot tortilla,

or a roasted plantain,

you eat it without bodyguards

and your sad

gourd-cup

is not tasted

first by an aide.

And afterward you play

if you want on

your guitar

a ranchera

song,

and you do not sleep

surrounded by searchlights

and barbed wire

translation.title: Epigram I
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the humble meal and music as freedom from the guarded life of power.
